files.README.md:
# sqlalchemy-sqlite-conversions-blog

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities, repositories and services with SQLAlchemy 2. It does not create or migrate the database.

## Settings

- Database: sqlite; code: synchronous (Session).
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return the entities.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
app/db.py              engine, sessions and the declarative base
app/errors.py          NotFoundError, ConflictError, ValidationFailedError: no HTTP codes
app/unit_of_work.py    the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
app/<table>/           entity, repository and service of each table
tests/                 repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json     what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
python -m pytest                       # SQLite in a temporary file
TEST_DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./app.db python -m pytest   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

"""Database engine, sessions and the declarative base of the entities (SQLAlchemy 2).

The URL comes from DATABASE_URL; see .env.example.
"""

import os

from sqlalchemy import Engine, create_engine, event
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, sessionmaker

DATABASE_URL = os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite:///./app.db")


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    """Base of every entity."""



def create_db_engine(url: str = DATABASE_URL) -> Engine:
    """An engine for the database at `url`. SQLite gets foreign keys turned on, as other databases have them."""
    engine = create_engine(url, pool_pre_ping=not url.startswith("sqlite"))
    if url.startswith("sqlite"):

        @event.listens_for(engine, "connect")
        def _foreign_keys(connection, _record) -> None:  # type: ignore[no-untyped-def]
            cursor = connection.cursor()
            cursor.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
            cursor.close()

    return engine


def create_session_factory(engine: Engine) -> sessionmaker[Session]:
    """Sessions that keep loaded rows readable after a commit."""
    return sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False)

"""Conversions between the application models and the "posts" table: what the service takes and returns."""

from __future__ import annotations

from app.application_models import Posts
from app.post.entity import Post


def posts_to_post(model: Posts) -> Post:
    """A Posts as the posts table takes it."""
    return Post(
        author_id=model.author_id,
        title=model.title,
        body=model.body,
    )


def post_to_posts(row: Post) -> Posts:
    """A row of the posts table as a Posts."""
    return Posts(
        id=row.id,
        author_id=row.author_id,
        title=row.title,
        body=row.body,
        # TODO: comment_ids: DB2CRUD does not write this conversion (comment_ids)
        comment_ids=None,
    )

files.app/unit_of_work.py:
"""The repositories of every table, and the transaction of each service operation. Each service operation runs in `transaction()`: committed when it ends, rolled back when it fails."""

from collections.abc import Iterator
from contextlib import AbstractContextManager, contextmanager
from typing import Protocol

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.author.repository import AuthorRepository, MemoryAuthorRepository, SqlAuthorRepository
from app.comment.repository import CommentRepository, MemoryCommentRepository, SqlCommentRepository
from app.post.repository import MemoryPostRepository, PostRepository, SqlPostRepository


class UnitOfWork(Protocol):
    """What services depend on: a repository per table and a transaction."""

    authors: AuthorRepository
    posts: PostRepository
    comments: CommentRepository

    def transaction(self) -> AbstractContextManager[None]:
        """Commits what runs inside it, or rolls it back if it fails."""
        ...


class SqlUnitOfWork:
    """The repositories over one Session."""

    def __init__(self, session: Session) -> None:
        self.session = session
        self.authors = SqlAuthorRepository(session)
        self.posts = SqlPostRepository(session)
        self.comments = SqlCommentRepository(session)

    @contextmanager
    def transaction(self) -> Iterator[None]:
        """Commits what runs inside it, or rolls it back if it fails."""
        try:
            yield
        except BaseException:
            self.session.rollback()
            raise
        self.session.commit()


class MemoryUnitOfWork:
    """The in-memory repositories, for tests and for trying the services without a database."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.authors = MemoryAuthorRepository()
        self.posts = MemoryPostRepository()
        self.comments = MemoryCommentRepository()

    @contextmanager
    def transaction(self) -> Iterator[None]:
        """Memory has no transactions: changes are kept as they are made."""
        yield

"""Fixtures of the tests: a database created from the entities, and the units of work."""

from collections.abc import Iterator
import os

import pytest

from app.author.entity import Author
from app.comment.entity import Comment
from app.db import Base, create_db_engine, create_session_factory
from app.post.entity import Post
from app.unit_of_work import MemoryUnitOfWork, SqlUnitOfWork

# Every entity is imported above, so the metadata knows every table


@pytest.fixture
def engine(tmp_path):  # type: ignore[no-untyped-def]
    """The test database, empty: TEST_DATABASE_URL, or SQLite in a temporary file."""
    url = os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL") or f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'test.db'}"
    engine = create_db_engine(url)
    Base.metadata.drop_all(engine)
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    yield engine
    Base.metadata.drop_all(engine)
    engine.dispose()


@pytest.fixture
def sql_uow(engine) -> Iterator[SqlUnitOfWork]:  # type: ignore[no-untyped-def]
    """The repositories over a session of the test database."""
    with create_session_factory(engine)() as session:
        yield SqlUnitOfWork(session)


@pytest.fixture
def memory_uow() -> MemoryUnitOfWork:
    """The in-memory repositories."""
    return MemoryUnitOfWork()

"""Tests of the "authors" table."""

import pytest
from tests.factories import add_author, new_author

from app.author.service import AuthorService
from app.errors import NotFoundError, ValidationFailedError
from app.unit_of_work import MemoryUnitOfWork, SqlUnitOfWork


def test_author_is_stored_and_read_back(sql_uow: SqlUnitOfWork) -> None:
    stored = add_author(sql_uow, 1)
    found = sql_uow.authors.find_by_id(stored.id)
    assert found is not None
    assert found.id == stored.id


def test_author_lists_rows_by_key(sql_uow: SqlUnitOfWork) -> None:
    add_author(sql_uow, 1)
    add_author(sql_uow, 2)
    page = sql_uow.authors.list(0, 1)
    assert page.total == 2
    assert len(page.items) == 1


def test_author_changes_are_stored(sql_uow: SqlUnitOfWork) -> None:
    stored = add_author(sql_uow, 1)
    stored.name = "changed"
    sql_uow.authors.update(stored)
    found = sql_uow.authors.find_by_id(stored.id)
    assert found is not None and found.name == "changed"


def test_author_is_deleted(sql_uow: SqlUnitOfWork) -> None:
    stored = add_author(sql_uow, 1)
    sql_uow.authors.delete(stored)
    assert sql_uow.authors.find_by_id(stored.id) is None


def test_author_service_creates_a_valid_row(memory_uow: MemoryUnitOfWork) -> None:
    service = AuthorService(memory_uow)
    n = 100
    created = service.create_author(new_author(1))
    found = service.get_author(created.id)
    assert found.id == created.id


def test_author_service_refuses_a_missing_value(memory_uow: MemoryUnitOfWork) -> None:
    service = AuthorService(memory_uow)
    n = 100
    with pytest.raises(ValidationFailedError) as raised:
        service.create_author(new_author(1, name=None))
    assert [error.field for error in raised.value.errors] == ["name"]


def test_author_service_says_when_a_row_is_missing(memory_uow: MemoryUnitOfWork) -> None:
    service = AuthorService(memory_uow)
    with pytest.raises(NotFoundError):
        service.get_author(999999)


def test_author_service_changes_a_row(memory_uow: MemoryUnitOfWork) -> None:
    service = AuthorService(memory_uow)
    n = 100
    created = service.create_author(new_author(1))
    updated = service.update_author(created.id, {"name": "changed"})
    assert updated.name == "changed"


def test_author_service_deletes_a_row(memory_uow: MemoryUnitOfWork) -> None:
    service = AuthorService(memory_uow)
    n = 100
    created = service.create_author(new_author(1))
    service.delete_author(created.id)
    with pytest.raises(NotFoundError):
        service.get_author(created.id)

"""Tests of the conversions between the application models and the tables."""

from tests.factories import add_author

from app.author.conversions import author_model_to_author, author_to_author_model
from app.unit_of_work import MemoryUnitOfWork


def test_author_goes_both_ways(memory_uow: MemoryUnitOfWork) -> None:
    """A row read as an Author and written back gives the same values."""
    row = add_author(memory_uow)
    model = author_to_author_model(row)
    assert model.id == row.id
    assert model.name == row.name
    assert model.created_at == row.created_at
    values = author_model_to_author(model)
    assert values.name == row.name
